trainer/30717.htm.text: Sorcerer Gauen: I am depressed by the things that are going on in this tower. How can the things people strive for differ, if they walk the same road... The Grand Masters all say that chaos is eminent. This chaos will only be restored by cooperation between hostile races, I am certain... I do have …
trainer/30717.htm.dpText: Magister Gauen: I am sorrowed to see such discord even here in this Tower. If we all pursue the same truth, how can we so easily turn on each other? The Grand Masters have long prophesied a coming wave of chaos that threatens to engulf us all. I suspect it can only be overcome if our races let go o…

trainer/30717-noteach.htm.text: Magister Gauen: I would like to teach you, but I only teach Elven Mystics. There are various Masters of different races here at the tower, I'm sure you'll find someone that can help you. Oh, and if you are a Cleric it will be best for you to visit a temple.

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30717-01.html.text: Magister Gauen: Kamael? What are you doing here? Oh, my! I have urgent business to attend to. Could you please come again later?

links.text: Hand him a controlling charm and tell the story about Magister Gaius.

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30717-04.html.text: Magister Gauen: Well, well. You're involved in a very complicated matter, and that's no lie. My advice is not to believe a word that comes out of Kaiena's mouth. I cannot say ought about Gaius, but it is clear that Kaiena had some sort of ulterior motive here.

links.text: What do you mean by that?

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30717-10.html.text: Magister Gauen: All this is a result of Kaiena's filthy greed. That is the truth. The tragedy is that we must endure this in order to prevent the Ivory Tower from becoming entangled in a political crisis with Giran.

Q00224_TestOfSagittarius/30717-01.html.text: Magister Gauen: I am Magister Gauen. Ah, yes, Commander Kadesh and the Crescent Arrow... That is a story that I'll never forget. Commander Kadesh is the most daring among all the sons of Shilen. He eats like a horse, yet he is always hungry! He is constantly growing... This caused anxiety among the…

Q00224_TestOfSagittarius/30717-03.html.text: Magister Gauen: To reconstitute the Crescent Arrow we need the materials that I previously requested. The horns of Manasen , a Reinforced Bowstring made of the swamp spider's web , a Mithril Ring which can be taken from a road scavenger and a chitin that can be obtained from a swamp stakato worker,…

Q00224_TestOfSagittarius/30717-04.html.text: Magister Gauen: 20 years ago Hamil and my master prevented the rebirth of Commander Kadesh... Take this bow to Hamil immediately!

Q00224_TestOfSagittarius/30717-02.html.text: Magister Gauen: Here is the Crescent Bow . This bow is different from other bows, as there is magic in it designed to kill Commander Kadesh. Keep in mind that you can only shoot a Wooden Arrow with this bow. You must kill Commander Kadesh with the Crescent Bow. Right now he is still somewhat weak b…

Q00356_DigUpTheSeaOfSpores/30717-01.htm.text: Magister Gauen: Since the era of Shunaiman, the first emperor of the ancient Elmoreden Empire, the Mystics of the Ivory Tower have been researching the Sea of Spores. Around E.D. 500 they constructed a force field tower which stopped the spread of that wretched sea. Their research has continued thr…

Q00356_DigUpTheSeaOfSpores/30717-06.htm.text: Magister Gauen: Since the era of Shunaiman, the first emperor of the ancient Elmoreden Empire, the Mystics of the Ivory Tower have been researching the Sea of Spores. Around E.D. 500 they constructed a force field tower which stopped the spread of that wretched sea. Their research has continued thr…

Q00356_DigUpTheSeaOfSpores/30717-13.html.text: Magister Gauen: Ah, you've returned! Give me the pouches. Hmm... Actually, I'm a little busy... Just put them anywhere...

links.text: "All of that trouble and you aren't even going to look at them?"

Q00356_DigUpTheSeaOfSpores/30717-12.html.text: Magister Gauen: Have you just returned from the Sea of Spores ? I see that you have filled the grey pouch. Due to inevitable...ah, shrinkage, I had hoped that you would fill both pouches. Well, no matter. What do you wish to do? Will you give me the grey pouch?

Q00356_DigUpTheSeaOfSpores/30717-08.html.text: Magister Gauen: Have you just returned from the Sea of Spores ? I see that you have filled the yellow pouch. Due to inevitable...ah, shrinkage, I had hoped that you would fill both pouches. Well, no matter. What do you wish to do? Will you give me the yellow pouch?

Q00356_DigUpTheSeaOfSpores/30717-07.html.text: Magister Gauen: Have you been to the Sea of Spores ? Bring me the spores from rotten trees in this yellow pouch and the spores from spore zombies in this grey pouch. Fill the pouches with 50 spores each and then bring them back to me.

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30717-03.html.text: Magister Gauen: Well, well. You're involved in a very complicated matter, and that's no lie. My advice is not to believe a word that comes out of Kaiena's mouth. I cannot say ought about Gaius, but it is clear that Kaiena had some sort of ulterior motive here.

links.text: What do you mean by that?

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30717-05.html.text: Magister Gauen: The only reason why Kaiena concocted this plan was to learn the secrets of the Giants' research documents. She only mentioned the followers of Beleth as an excuse to justify her actions. The fact that she ordered Gaius to involve the monster and carry out this plan tells me that som…

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30717-06.html.text: Magister Gauen: We attempted to recover the research documents precisely to prevent them from falling into the wrong hands...

links.text: Then you must be eager to find them.

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30717-07.html.text: Magister Gauen: Oh yes! Somehow Kaiena learned about our mission and launched an attack to steal the documents.

links.text: Does that mean Kaiena and her men obtained the documents?

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30717-09.html.text: Magister Gauen: Both Kaiena's men and our forces were exhausted from fighting each other. At that moment, Beleth's well-known female minion appeared and took the documents. Undoubtedly Beleth was as eager to possess those documents as Kaiena was. He must have learned about them through our quarrel …

Q00356_DigUpTheSeaOfSpores/30717-02.htm.text: Magister Gauen: Frankly, I'm not sure. Up to now our research has been focused on sustaining and strengthening the magic force field tower. However, it has become clear that we need a more permanent solution. For this we must return to the Sea of Spores itself. We must shift our strategy to researc…

Q00356_DigUpTheSeaOfSpores/30717-03.htm.text: Magister Gauen: I must have a tissue sample of an organism that has joined with spores and grown root. Rotting Tree Spores and Spore zombies will do nicely.
Q00356_DigUpTheSeaOfSpores/30717-03.htm.dpText: Magister Gauen: I must have a tissue sample of an organism that has joined with spores and grown roots. Rotting Tree Spores and spore zombies will do nicely.

Q00356_DigUpTheSeaOfSpores/30717-04.htm.text: Magister Gauen: There are many different types of spores, all with unique and often dangerous characteristics. Are you sure you want to do this?

Q00356_DigUpTheSeaOfSpores/30717-05.htm.text: Magister Gauen: Your resolve is admirable! Go and get the spores that live as parasites on rotten trees and spore zombies . Put the spores from the spore zombies in this grey pouch and put the spores from the rotten trees in this yellow pouch. The capacity of the pouches varies according to the siz…
Q00356_DigUpTheSeaOfSpores/30717-05.htm.dpText: Magister Gauen: Your resolve is admirable! Go and get the spores that live as parasites on rotten trees and spore zombies . Put the spores from the spore zombies in this grey pouch and put the spores from the rotten trees in this yellow pouch. The capacity of the pouches varies according to the siz…

Q00356_DigUpTheSeaOfSpores/30717-09.html.text: Magister Gauen: Do you wish to continue collecting spores or would you like to quit?

Q00356_DigUpTheSeaOfSpores/30717-10.html.text: Magister Gauen: Go to the Sea of Spores and bring back the spores that are parasites on the bodies of rotten trees and spore zombies . Collect 50 of each kind in each of the two pouches. Please do this and restore peace to the community.

Q00356_DigUpTheSeaOfSpores/30717-11.html.text: Magister Gauen: Thank you very much. If you ever return to the Sea of Spores, come and see me.

Q00356_DigUpTheSeaOfSpores/30717-14.html.text: Magister Gauen: Please put them in that box over there. Thanks to you, we can continue to conduct highly productive and effective research. Your contribution will be duly noted. Would you like to help us some more?

Q00356_DigUpTheSeaOfSpores/30717-15.html.text: Magister Gauen: Oh yes, this is great! Splendid work! Even experts aren't so neat! You must be rewarded! Please take this. You have greatly aided our research. I may ask for your assistance again. You are very good at this!

Q00356_DigUpTheSeaOfSpores/30717-16.html.text: Magister Gauen: Here we go... I acknowledge that I received from you 50 Herbivorous Spores and 50 carnivorous spores. Here is your reward. If you wish, come back and help me again. We have enough for now, but I'm sure that in the future we shall need more.

Q00356_DigUpTheSeaOfSpores/30717-17.html.text: Magister Gauen: What's this? They're all crushed together ! I can't count them when they're like this... Well, they feel to be about the right weight... They have been too badly damaged to be useful for our research. But a deal's a deal, I shall pay you. If you wish to continue in this job, you mus…

Q00356_DigUpTheSeaOfSpores/30717-18.html.text: Magister Gauen: I'm sorry, I was distracted. Let's see, first we must sort them... What do we have here?

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change. General Skill Enchanting This method of enchanting requires 1 [Giant's Codex] and a certain amount of SP and adena to complete. If the enchant attem…
